description: A hierarchical list of expandable branches and selectable leaves — the WAI-ARIA tree view, with connector guide lines and an optional breadcrumb of the selected node's ancestry.

props.name: defaultExpandedValues
props.description:
Branch values expanded on first render when uncontrolled. Omit for a
fully-collapsed tree.

props.name: defaultSelectedValue
props.description:
The value selected on first render when uncontrolled. `null` selects
nothing.

props.name: defaultSelectedValues
props.description: The values selected on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: expandedValues
props.description:
The set of expanded branch values, owned by the consumer. Keep in
sync via `onExpandedChange`.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description:
Called with the full set of expanded branch values whenever a branch
is toggled. Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the full set of expanded branch values the user requested
on each toggle. Required in controlled mode.

props.name: onSelectedValueChange
props.description:
Called with the newly-selected value (or `null` when cleared) on each
user selection. Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the value the user requested to select (or `null` when
cleared). Required in controlled mode.

props.name: onSelectedValuesChange
props.description:
Called with the full selected set (in selection order) on each
change. Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the full selected set (in selection order) the user
requested. Required in controlled mode.

props.name: selectedValue
props.description:
The selected value, owned by the consumer (or `null` for no
selection). Keep it in sync via `onSelectedValueChange`.

props.name: selectedValues
props.description:
The selected values, owned by the consumer. Keep in sync via
`onSelectedValuesChange`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
At most one node may be selected; see {@link SelectionMode}.
Many nodes may be selected via `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+click and `Shift`+click
ranges; see {@link SelectionMode}.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Row size for the whole tree; `data-density` scales each size further.

contractProps.name: connectors
contractProps.description: Whether nested rows are joined to their parent by hairline guide lines.

props.name: value
props.description:
Stable identifier for this item, unique within the tree. Links the
item to selection / expansion state and to its
{@link TreePathSegment} in a resolved path.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the item as the supplied child element instead of `<div>`,
merging the treeitem behaviour onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern.
The child must accept a `ref`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disable selection and remove the item from roving navigation
(`Home`/`End` still skip past it to a non-disabled neighbour).

props.name: label
props.description:
Optional display label for this item. Stored alongside the value
in the tree's node registry so {@link useTreePath } and
`Tree.SelectionPath` can surface it without an external lookup.
Has no effect on what `Tree.Item` renders.

props.name: value
props.description:
Stable identifier for this branch, unique within the tree. Also seeds
the `parentValue` of its {@link TreeBranchContent }'s children and the
derived `aria-labelledby` control id.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disable selection, expansion-toggling, and roving navigation for
this branch. The branch and its current content remain rendered.

props.name: label
props.description:
Optional display label for this branch. Stored alongside the value
in the tree's node registry so {@link useTreePath } and
`Tree.SelectionPath` can surface it without an external lookup.
Has no effect on what `Tree.Branch` renders.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the control as the supplied child element instead of `<div>`,
merging its props (including the `aria-labelledby` id) onto the child
via the {@link Slot } pattern. The child must accept a `ref`.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the content mounted while the branch is collapsed so CSS can
animate it in and out. When collapsed it is hidden from assistive
technology with `aria-hidden` and carries `data-state="closed"`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as the supplied child element instead of `<span>`, merging
`aria-hidden` and `data-state` onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern
(e.g. an icon that rotates on `data-state="open"`).

props.name: children
props.description:
Either standard React children (ignored — the subcomponent does its
own rendering) or a render-prop receiving the resolved selection
paths so consumers can lay out custom markup.

props.name: separator
props.description:
Node passed to each `Breadcrumb.Separator` in the default rendering.
Defaults to Breadcrumb's built-in `"/"` glyph.

api.description:
`<primitiv-tree>` — the state owner of a WAI-ARIA tree view: nested items and branches, one roving tab stop, branches expanded and collapsed, and single or multiple selection.

The root finds its own parts, so a tree nested inside another keeps its own, and reconciles them from its reflected attributes whenever a part arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute it reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s). Each item and branch gets its `aria-level`, `data-depth` and the `--primitiv-tree-depth` custom property a stylesheet indents by, from where it sits.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected values, space-separated, in the order they were selected. Reflected: it changes as the user selects, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live selection.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: The expanded branches' values, space-separated. Reflected, like `value`.

attributes.name: selection-mode
attributes.description: `multiple` allows several values: Ctrl or Meta toggles one, Shift selects a range. Defaults to `single`.

events.name: primitiv-tree-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user's selection applies, with the selection afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-tree-expanded-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user expands or collapses a branch, with the expanded branches afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-tree-item>` — a leaf. Structural: it *is* the treeitem, focusable with the roving tab stop, and a click selects it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The item's value, unique in the tree.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The name a selection path shows for it. Defaults to its `value`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Marks it disabled: it is skipped by the arrow keys and never selected.

api.description: `<primitiv-tree-branch>` — a node with children. Structural: it *is* the treeitem, named by its row, and holds a `<primitiv-tree-branch-control>` (the row) and a `<primitiv-tree-branch-content>` (the children) as direct children.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The branch's value, unique in the tree.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The name a selection path shows for it. Defaults to its `value`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Marks it disabled: it is skipped by the arrow keys, never selected and never toggled.

api.description:
`<primitiv-tree-branch-control>` — a branch's row. A click on it toggles the branch and selects it; it gets an id the branch is labelled by.

The two are separate events, so each can be vetoed alone. A page outline whose branches are section headings, never selected, cancels `primitiv-tree-change` when its value names a branch; the branch still toggles, because `primitiv-tree-expanded-change` is not cancelled.

`<primitiv-tree-branch-content>` — a branch's children. Structural: the root gives it `role="group"`, `data-depth`, `data-state`, and `hidden` and `aria-hidden` while its branch is collapsed (write `hidden` in your markup too, so it is hidden before the script loads).

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep it rendered while collapsed (`aria-hidden` rather than `hidden`), so a stylesheet can animate it.

api.description: `<primitiv-tree-branch-indicator>` — the glyph that shows whether its branch is open. Structural: the root gives it `aria-hidden` and `data-state`.

`<primitiv-tree-selection-path>` — the selected items' ancestry, one breadcrumb trail per selected item, rebuilt as the selection changes. It renders React's headless Breadcrumb markup — a `<nav>` of an `<ol>` whose crumbs carry `data-tree-selection-segment`, the last `aria-current="page"` — or, given a `<template>` child holding one `<nav>` with a crumb, a current crumb and a `role="presentation"` separator, clones of yours. It carries `data-empty` while nothing is selected.

It must be a descendant of its `<primitiv-tree>`, which is what finds it. To show the path somewhere else on the page, listen for `primitiv-tree-change` and render a Breadcrumb from its `value` yourself.
